name: Gateway Distriparks Ltd
title: Gateway Distriparks Ltd - 543489 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Rail volumes stay subdued on West Asia disruption with no clarity on recovery; Q4 volume about 188,000 TEUs (96,000 rail, 91,000 CFS), double-stacking averaged 40%, and Snowman margins fell on start-up costs.

utilisation.quote: We were at around 86%, 87% for the last financial year.

capex.quote: So this INR100 crores will come in the next 2 years.

triggers.label: West Asia volumes still subdued
triggers.quote: The trend is continuing right now. So, volumes remain a bit subdued

triggers.label: Snowman INR1,000 cr revenue may slip
triggers.quote: Maybe it gets deferred by a year or so.

triggers.label: Warehouse price hikes passed through
triggers.quote: We have had a couple of price increases required this year

triggers.label: Snowman capex guided ~INR50 cr FY27
triggers.quote: Maybe around INR50 crores capex is the guideline for FY '27.

guidance.quote: we would be trying to target a 15% growth for the rail segment
Snowman also, we're targeting about a 15% growth.

guidance.metric: Snowman revenue INR1,000 crore at 15% blended EBITDA margin
guidance.quote: Maybe it gets deferred by a year or so.
We've given a target of 2 028 for commencement of operations.

red_flags.quote: given that you had INR14 crores of cash on hand for March end?
